_comment: Part patches (merged by id) fixing two inherited chicken-and-egg deadlocks: a morph attribute required a tag the human starting part lacked, so the morph could never begin.

parts._patch: attr.beak requires beak_tag and morphs the mouth; a human mouth lacked beak_tag, so birds never got a beak.
attr.paw_pads requires foot_tag and morphs toes; human toes lacked foot_tag, so no genome ever got paw-toes.
attr.muzzle requires head_tag; a human face lacked it, so a face-sited muzzle could not apply (the head role carried it, so this is symmetry).
